agent.name: pad_create
agent.description: Create a shared Pad. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: CreateParams
inputSchema.description: Create a shared Pad.

agent.name: pad_read
agent.description: Read one Pad. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

agent.name: pad_list
agent.description: List every Pad. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

agent.name: pad_rename
agent.description: Rename any Pad, keeping its creation and text. Pass the exact original name and expectedIncarnation from a read in this Project. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: RenameParams
inputSchema.description:
Rename this exact creation under its captured, exact spelling.
Incarnations are Project-scoped: submit on the originally captured Project connection.
Missing name is NOT_FOUND; a changed spelling/incarnation or occupied destination is
CONFLICT. Refusal changes no text, mirror, Touch or Event. Content Revision is unchanged.

agent.name: pad_write
agent.description: Rewrite a Pad's whole text. Optional expectedRevision refuses a stale write with CONFLICT. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: WriteParams
inputSchema.description:
Rewrite the whole text. Supplied guards are checked in the same write transaction.
`expectedRevision` mismatch is CONFLICT naming the current Revision.
`expectedIncarnation` mismatch is CONFLICT; a missing Pad is NOT_FOUND.
Omitted guards keep name-based current-content semantics.

expectedIncarnation.description: Creation captured with the draft in its original Project. Independent of content Revision.

agent.name: pad_append
agent.description: Add text to the end of any Pad. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: AppendParams
inputSchema.description: Add to the end. Anyone; counts as a write in Provenance.

agent.name: pad_appendSection
agent.description: Add text at the end of the section under a Markdown heading of any Pad; the heading ignores case and extra whitespace. Pass expectedRevision (from a read) to refuse if the Pad changed since. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: AppendSectionParams
inputSchema.description:
Add under a Markdown heading: at the end of its section. Anyone; counts as a write in Provenance (P15).
`heading` ignores case, runs of whitespace and leading `#`. With `expectedRevision`, the call fails with `CONFLICT` when the Pad's revision differs.

agent.name: pad_move
agent.description: Move a Pad to a Workstream or the Project root. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: MoveParams
inputSchema.description: Moves a Pad to a Workstream, or to the Project root when `home` is `None`.

agent.name: pad_delete
agent.description: Delete a Pad, retaining its original creation for restoration. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: DeleteParams
inputSchema.description:
Delete the current Pad, retaining its authoritative state in the same transaction.
Supply an operation before dispatch to reconcile a lost reply using `pad.getDeletion`.
Reusing an operation with different guards refuses; it never deletes a replacement.

agent.name: pad_redoDelete
agent.description: Redo a restored Pad deletion with an acknowledged creation, Revision and Home; retain the current authoritative state for Undo. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: RedoDeleteParams
inputSchema.description:
Redo a restored deletion in its original Project. The fresh operation key is
reconciled with pad.getDeletion and equal replay never repeats effects.
Guards come from an acknowledged Pad read in that Project, not a client snapshot.
A changed creation, name, Revision or Home is CONFLICT; current deletion authority
is checked again. Refusal retains both operations and permits retry after repair
or a fresh acknowledged read. Success retains current authoritative content and
placement for pad.restore using the returned operation, including later cycles.

agent.name: pad_getDeletion
agent.description: Reconcile an unknown Pad deletion on its originating Project. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: GetDeletionParams
inputSchema.description:
Reconcile an unknown deletion on its originating Project connection. Returns
NOT_FOUND if no operation committed; that is the only safe signal to retry deletion.

agent.name: pad_restore
agent.description: Restore your retained Pad deletion once, without replaying external effects. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: DeletionId
inputSchema.description: Originating Project and deletion operation; neither grants authority.

agent.name: pad_export
agent.description: Write a Pad's text to a file at an absolute path. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

agent.name: pad_setStorage
agent.description: Choose whether the Project mirrors its Pads to files. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

inputSchema.title: SetStorageParams
inputSchema.description:
Project-wide. `true` mirrors every Pad to `pads/<name>.md` in the Project's data folder (N1); the app database stays the source of truth.
`false` stops mirroring and first imports edits made to those files.
